howItWorks.heading: Three steps. Then it works.
howItWorks.intro: No prompt engineering. A job description and your documents.

steps.title: Describe the role
steps.body: Pick a template. Name it. Give it a voice and one plain rule for when to fetch a human.

steps.title: Hand it your context
steps.body: Upload the policies, price lists and FAQs. It answers from those and cites them.

steps.title: Publish and delegate
steps.body: Put it on your site. Give it a schedule. Review everything it produces from one inbox.

bento.heading: Everything a good hire needs.
bento.intro: The roles, and the platform underneath them.

cards.title: One inbox for approvals
cards.body: Every post and email an agent wants to send lands here with the full text. Approve, edit or reject. From your phone, if that's where you are.

cards.title: Eight roles. One click.
cards.body: Each one is a job, a voice and a rule for when to stop.

cards.title: Works on a schedule
cards.body: A scope of work, a cadence or a webhook. It runs overnight and reports in the morning.

cards.title: Answers with sources
cards.body: From your documents and cited research. When it doesn't know, it says so.

cards.title: A complete trail
cards.body: Every tool call, approval and schedule. Queryable. Exportable.

cards.title: A widget for your site
cards.body: One script tag, or a chat link. A passcode if you want one.

cards.title: Yours stays yours
cards.body: Credentials encrypted at rest. Nothing you upload trains a model.

pricing.heading: Pricing that follows the work.

pricing.footnote: Every plan includes every role, unlimited teammates, the audit log and email support.
